summary: TORM plc filed a Form 6-K disclosing a secondary block trade in which selling shareholder OCM Njord Holdings S.a r.l., indirectly owned by Oaktree-managed funds, sold 9,000,000 Class A common shares to J.P. Morgan and other underwriters under a September 14, 2026 underwriting agreement, with delivery September 16. An additional 1,350,000-share 30-day option was granted. No proceeds went to TORM, so this is purely a sponsor sell-down reducing Oaktree's overhang, not a company capital raise. Watch pricing discount, remaining stake and further sell-down risk.
